note: The user-supplied rigged supercar becomes the fictional 'Revontuli'. Emblems, lettering, the number plate and every source texture are removed before export (plan section 18 rule 3); flat two-tone paint. For Snow the seats sit lower and further forward and the wheel nearer. Only visual meshes are exported; the authoring rig stays in Blender. Snow's ways in and out are fitted to this cabin (content/assets/snow-vehicle-poses-revontuli.json).

nodes.wheelRule: each wheel node's origin is the hub centre, the wheel spins about its local +X axle; the wheel mesh is a child of (or is) the node; FL = front left = +X +Z
nodes.doorRule: optional; origin on the hinge line, opens about local +Y by extras.openDeg (0..70)
nodes.steeringRule: optional; origin at the hub, turns about its local +Z, extras.lockDeg

sockets.purpose: ground point where the driver appears on exit (left side, 1.5 m out)
ground point on the right side
centre of mass, low and slightly forward
roof centre where the patrol light bar sits

variants.paint: aurora green with a graphite second tone (the source two-tone split)

materials: paint (metallic 0.6, roughness 0.35, KHR_materials_clearcoat welcome), glass (alpha blend 0.4), rubber, alloy, lamp emissive, interior; textures baked or dropped; no 2K leather maps
